questions.prompt: What happens when a function executes return value?
options: All variables in the module are cleared.
The function finishes and provides that value to its caller.
The value is printed automatically in every environment.

questions.explanation: A return value can be reused and tested independently of console output.

questions.prompt: How should an asynchronous operation that may fail be handled?
options: Assume a rejected Promise converts to null.
Use setTimeout to suppress the rejection.
Ignore the rejection if the call is inside a function.
Handle rejections with try/catch around await or with an appropriate .catch().
questions.explanation: Async failures must be propagated or handled deliberately to avoid unhandled rejections and unclear UI state.
